scope: Construction vehicle docking DataVault descriptor sovereignty

problem.summary: VehicleDockingModule hot-swapped DataVault through a direct cast and accepted docking telemetry handles by generic/nonzero descriptor checks before read, write-lock, and release paths.
problem.risk: A stale or wrong VehiclesPhysics handle could enter the docking telemetry ring or cursor path after DataVault churn. This is a descriptor sovereignty defect, not a gameplay/physics tuning issue.

changes.detail: DataVault callback now pattern-matches IDataVault before lifecycle rebinding.
Dock telemetry ring and cursor paths now require exact BufferID plus SystemID.VehiclesPhysics plus nonzero generation before read, write lock, and release.

write_lock_proof.finally_release_note: Existing DockTelemetryWriter.Dispose finally path releases cursor and ring write locks; this patch added exact handle gates before each release and before each acquisition.

git_diff_check.only_warning: LF will be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches it

scalability_and_cinematic_cheat.note: No docking physics, cargo, spline, impact, wake, or visual simulation was changed. The existing visual/telemetry behavior remains continuous; this patch only hardens native descriptor ownership.
